thresholds.rationale: ~one high-severity single signal (e.g. an Item 2.04 at severity 1.0, weight ~0.30) -- routine automated sweep, most sensitive tier; this is the tier the composite case (3 subthreshold signals combining) is built to clear
~two independent high-severity signals combining -- escalates to a human reviewer
~three independent high-severity signals combining -- reserved for the most severe composite cases

|pct_change| must be >= this AND in the adverse direction for its tag (see ADVERSE_DIRECTION) to become a signal_event; chosen at roughly the measured 80th percentile of the 3,705-row reference table's |pct_change| distribution (p75=25.0, p80=33.5, p90=73.4). 383 of 3705 reference deltas were admitted: 2588 excluded below threshold, 489 excluded as favorable-direction, 236 excluded as a direction-neutral tag, 9 excluded as a genuine zero-to-zero (no real change), 11 admitted from an undefined (zero-prior) pct_change on the strength of direction alone.

thresholds.rule: severity *= (precision_review.sampled - .off_topic) / .sampled for any LEI coverage flags recommended_use == 'down_weight'

thresholds.rationale: confirmation = single-day market_oas_bp rise >= this fraction of the obligor's sector divergence_threshold_bp; anticipation = rolling-mean(idiosyncratic_bp, ROLL_WINDOW) rise vs. the prior ROLL_WINDOW block >= this fraction. Calibrated against measured baseline noise (p95 day-over-day market_oas_bp ~10bp, p95 20-vs-20 idiosyncratic_bp rolling delta ~7bp) and the four real loaded crossings (confirmation jumps measured 92-150bp).
